reasons.dead|span.mm-row-rank: The matchmaker's rank number is a LABEL in the first column of a register row, and the row's height is set by the last cell, which carries the meters. A rank is one number, not a block of type; the space beneath it is the row's measure, not an empty region. The same shape is accepted on the champions' tag key and on the Critic's three short cells.
reasons.dead|span.t-key: The champions' tag key is a label in the first column of a register row whose height is set by the producer's name and contact columns — which are the content. The space below a label in a register row is the row's measure.
reasons.dead|span.critic-c-n: The Critic's row number is a label in the first column of a four-column register whose FOURTH column carries the registry's answer — prose, and the reason the row is tall. The space beneath the number is the row's measure.
reasons.dead|span.critic-c-who: The Critic's attribution cell is a label in the third column of a register row whose fourth column carries the registry's answer. The space beneath it is the row's measure.
reasons.dead|span.critic-c-claim: The Critic's claim cell is a label in the second column of a register row whose fourth column carries the registry's answer. The space beneath it is the row's measure.
reasons.dead|span.hs-photo-by: The photograph's credit is one line in a caption block whose height is set by the year, the caption and the plate navigation. The space beneath the credit is the caption's measure.
reasons.dead|div.mm-ctrl-grp: The matchmaker's control group sits in the last column of a register row whose first cell carries the heading and the meters. The space beneath it is the row's measure.
reasons.wrap|div.mm-row-h: The matchmaker's row heading wraps at the widths where its column is narrow — a line breaking, not a hole.
reasons.wrap|div.hs-photo-nav: The history view's plate navigation wraps at the widths where the plates do not fit on one line — a line breaking, not a hole.
reasons.wrap|p.sp-src: The soft-power view's source line wraps onto a second line because the seven instruments' names do not fit on one — a line breaking, not a hole.
reasons.clip|span.ch-card-img-text: The caption band over the photograph is two lines tall by design. The band is 44px on a 140px picture and the caption runs to five or six lines, so a band tall enough to hold it would eat the photograph — which is the reason the card is there at all. The ellipsis says there is more, the whole caption is the image's alt text, and the province dossier carries it in full. The credit that used to share this band now sits under the picture, where none of it is cut.
